content.title: School closings announced for Monday amid severe weather threat
content.text: Is school closed on Monday? Find out here. VIRGINIA, USA — A Weather Impact Alert has been issued for Hampton Roads on Monday, March 16, as a strong cold front moves through the region, bringing the threat for strong to severe thunderstorms during the afternoon and evening hours. Some schools have announced they will be closed due to the forecast. Closings and cancellations below are for Monday, March 16, 2026. This is NOT a live updating list.
